sourceText: User (2026-07-06): 强制显示 ledger — force the status ledger to always be shown to the user after mutating commands, and require it to go through the Lattice story workflow with genuine 3x2 verification and a version bump.
normalizedOutcome: After any story-scoped mutating command, the CLI always prints a status ledger (a checklist-derived one when no milestone ledger exists), and a render failure is shown visibly on stdout instead of being swallowed to stderr.
acceptanceClaim: A no-ledger story running a mutating command emits a Checklist-derived ledger block on stdout, never the Milestone Status header, and a render failure surfaces a visible warning while the exit code stays 0.
